source: FBR Circular No. 02 of 2026-27 · Finance Act 2026
headline: OVERSEAS PAKISTANI?
YOUR NRVA MAY

blocks.text: Every Pakistani bank account means filing a return.
No return if your only Pakistan income is

items: **Profit** on FCVA, FCBVA, NRVA or NRVBA balances
**Profit on government securities** bought through them
**Gains or dividends** on PSX shares, funds or property bought this way
